geklojban-1.2.3 is an unofficial version of CLL ([[The Complete Lojban Language]]) book.

geklojban-1.2.3 is not necessarily approved by the LLG ([[Logical Language Group]]) and therefore is not recommended to use.

The only reason for its existence is to test new features and send it for approval to the LLG.

== How to use ==

* read the so called [http://vrici.lojban.org/~gleki/build/cll_diffs/cll_difference_prefixed.pdf "difference" PDF document] that compares geklojban-1.2.3 to CLL published in 2016 (2016-08-27 release). The document has insertions marked with green and "ins`" prefix and deletions marked with red and "del`" prefix. Prefixes are added so that you can use Cmd+F or Ctrl+F to quickly find the differences in the PDF document. There is [http://vrici.lojban.org/~gleki/build/cll_diffs/cll_difference.pdf an alternative difference version without prefixes] (but then you'll have to manually scroll the document to find the differences).
* Read the difference document in HTML format: [http://vrici.lojban.org/~gleki/build/cll_diffs/diff_new_xhtml_no_chunks/difference_prefixed.html with prefixes], [http://vrici.lojban.org/~gleki/build/cll_diffs/diff_new_xhtml_no_chunks/difference_prefixed.html without prefixes].
* read the final document that is to be used for printing and publication. Notice that the title page has the document explicitly marked as "geklojban-1.2.3" and has the name of the organization published it different from LLG; this is done to emphasize that it's not an LLG publication:
** [http://vrici.lojban.org/~gleki/build/cll.pdf PDF format].
** [http://vrici.lojban.org/~gleki/build/cll.epub EPUB format].
** [http://vrici.lojban.org/~gleki/build/xhtml_section_chunks/ HTML format, one page is one section of the book].
** [http://vrici.lojban.org/~gleki/build/ HTML format - the whole book in one very long page].

== Short list of changes ==

* [[Dotside]] implemented
* "cmene" and "cmevla" concepts are now separated
* '''sumti tcita''' is renamed to '''sumtcita'''
* '''mi kucli le jei broda''' is now '''mi kucli tu'a le jei broda'''
* Dictionary with examples is now technically possible: the glossary can now have examples below definitions of words (and does so for the word '''coi''' as a showcase)
* immense amount of mistypes and minor errors fixed
